features.note: Pause and Resume work on the Record row and in Recording > Pause Recording: each pause closes a part of the take and the parts join when it ends, tested headless in voicememos.rs and store.rs. Not verified on Midget.
features.wire: Check on Midget: pause mid-take, resume, stop; the saved recording plays both parts in order.

features.feature: Recordings list with dates and durations

features.note: Delete moves a recording into the hidden .deleted folder with a record of when and from where; the Recently Deleted row offers Recover and Delete Forever, and recordings older than 30 days are purged at launch. Tested in store.rs and voicememos.rs; not verified on Midget.
features.wire: Check on Midget: delete a recording, find it in Recently Deleted, recover it to its folder.

features.note: Recording > Replace picks a span with the trim handles and records over it; the result is saved as a new copy with the span swapped and the original kept. The splice and the copy are tested in store.rs; not verified on Midget.
features.wire: Check on Midget: pick a span, record over it; the result is saved as a new copy, not over the original

features.note: The transport's Slower and Faster stepper moves through 0.5x, 1x, 1.5x and 2x. audiod time-stretches the audio, so the pitch stays the same, and the speed is saved per recording as a hidden sidecar. Tested headless: protocol round trip, output length, a 1 kHz tone keeps its pitch by DFT, the sidecar. Not verified on Midget.
features.wire: Check on Midget: play a memo at 1.5x and listen for the same pitch; the take is about two thirds as long; reopen the memo and the speed is still 1.5x.

features.note: Recording > Export opens the shell's save panel, writes the WAV through the document callback and then reports it saved. Not verified on Midget.
features.wire: Check on Midget: Recording > Export opens the save panel and the file is written

features.note: Library > New Folder creates folders, Move to Folder files a recording into one, and the sidebar lists them; deleting a folder moves its recordings up. Tested in store.rs; not verified on Midget.
features.wire: Check on Midget: New Folder, Move to Folder, then Delete Folder with recordings inside.

features.note: Library > Favourite marks a recording with a hidden sidecar that follows renames and moves, and the Favourites row lists the marked ones. Tested in store.rs; not verified on Midget.
features.wire: Check on Midget: mark a recording, rename it, find it under Favourites; unmarking removes it.

features.note: The search field under the sidebar title narrows the list by title and notes, and every word must match. Tested in store.rs and voicememos.rs; not verified on Midget.
features.wire: Check on Midget: type a word from a title and from the notes; both narrow the list.

features.note: No local speech-to-text engine exists. The repo ships only the SDK model springboard/sdk/src/speech_recognizer.rs (RecognitionBackend, with a test fake); no whisper, vosk or other engine is shipped or referenced, so nothing can transcribe a memo yet.
features.wire: Needs a local speech-to-text engine first (none is installed or referenced). Then run it in the background on a recording, store the text in a sidecar, and show it in the notes pane.

features.note: Recording > Input lists the input devices and sets the default one. There is no quality or format option, because the audio service records one fixed format. Not verified on Midget.
features.wire: Sample rate and quality need a format option in the audio service; there is no settings window
